title: S-0003 replay-shadow corpus seed: capture 30 worker turns
body_md: S-0003 promises replay-shadow as the confidence primitive: 'Run on a corpus (~30) before promoting prompt/template/model/skill-set changes.' bin/arc-replay.ts scaffold has merged but no corpus exists.
